title: Lee Kang-in joins Atlético Madrid from PSG on five-year deal
dek: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in, 25, transferred from Paris Saint-Germain to Atlético Madrid on a five-year contract through June 30, 2031. Lee made 124 appearances for PSG, scoring 16 goals and providing 16 assists while winning 12 trophies including two Champions League titles and three Ligue 1 crowns.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Lee Kang-in signed a five-year deal with Atlético Madrid running through June 30, 2031.
bottom_line: Lee Kang-in now carries proven Champions League experience into La Liga at 25, a point in his career where depth or starting status will clarify his impact. Watch whether Atlético uses him as an immediate starter or phases him into the squad, and whether his assist numbers from Paris transfer to Spanish football.
body: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-in has completed a transfer to Atlético Madrid from Paris Saint-Germain on a five-year contract running through June 30, 2031, according to ESPN reporting. The 25-year-old midfielder brings European pedigree and trophy experience to the La Liga club during the summer transfer window.

Lee's career path traces through Spanish football before his PSG move. He made his professional debut with Valencia in October 2018 in the Copa del Rey and appeared 62 times for the Spanish side before joining Mallorca in August 2021, where he spent two seasons.

His spell at PSG, from summer 2023 onward, produced significant output: 124 appearances, 16 goals, and 16 assists, per ESPN. During three years in Paris, Lee won 12 trophies, including two Champions League titles and three Ligue 1 championships.

On the international stage, Lee made his senior debut for South Korea in September 2019 and has earned 50 caps with 10 goals, per ESPN reporting. He recently played in all three of South Korea's Group A fixtures at this year's World Cup.

The transfer moves Lee to a new league at an age when European players typically establish themselves as core squad contributors. The brief does not disclose a transfer fee or detail his expected role within Atlético's midfield structure.
